tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: jp_warnings
tools.description: Which JMA weather emergency warnings, warnings and advisories are in effect in this Japanese prefecture now? Structured JSON in English and Japanese (type, level, status, areas with JMA's English names, issued_at, source URL). Relay only; no independent forecast.

tools.name: jp_typhoons
tools.description: Which typhoons is JMA issuing bulletins for right now, and what do the bulletins forecast? Number, name, center position, central pressure, maximum wind, issue time, and forecast-circle centers, radii and times, relayed as structured JSON from JMA bulletins (VPTW60-65). tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call (e.g. jp_trip_impact_check) by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 30 days after settlement.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "jp_volcanoes" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
